result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same landscape command as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles and its existing tests pass. I didn't run either command or `-help`, so the dispatch, `-help` output and `-analysisRoot` behaviour are untested. I also added no new test.

- **`Commands.java`:**
  - I added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:**
  - Both names go to the same `updateLandscape(args)` handler.
  - `-help` prints the usage and description of whichever name was typed, so `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`:** the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is kept as the same command so existing scripts keep working.
- **`CLAUDE.md`:** I also updated its command list to mention the new name, which you didn't ask for.
